verdict.rationale: Poly stores notes as standard files: journal entries are Markdown files in the Mind folder, and the desktop app exposes your Poly files as a real folder in Finder or Explorer, so content is readable outside the app. However, it is a cloud-synced store where files download on demand and sync back, not a local-first store, and nothing documents full offline operation (search, agent, indexing). Missing for 10: documented local-first storage with the full copy on disk, an explicit offline mode for all features, and independent hands-on confirmation of offline behavior.
